title: 借景
standfirst: 一道门，一条街缝，一层近处的叶。远方从这些边缘之间显出来。
standfirstEn: A gate, a gap in a street, a layer of nearby leaves. Distance appears between these edges.
introduction: 门内的柱梁先占住近处，城市与山留在开口里。到了窄街，围住远方的换成两侧楼体。远处仍然很大，眼前的边缘却决定了这次能看见多少。
六幅照片让门、石阶与枝叶留在取景中。它们没有被移开以获得一个完整的景物：目光经过近处，再抵达较远的形状。
introductionEn: Posts and beams occupy the near view while city and hills remain within an opening. In a narrow street, buildings at either side take their place. The distance stays large; the nearer edges decide how much of it enters this view.
Six photographs keep gates, steps and leaves within the frame. They remain as the eye passes through what is nearby towards forms farther away.

chapters.title: 门与步径
chapters.text: 石阶把人物送到亮处，灰色门框又退到树影之中。经过的方向各不相同，开口始终与近处相接。
chapters.textEn: Steps carry figures towards brightness; grey gates recede into tree shadows. The routes differ, but the openings stay connected to what lies nearby.

chapters.title: 叶的边缘
chapters.text: 柱列与双塔各有整齐的轮廓，近处的枝叶却留下不规则的边。远方从这些间隙里显出，也保留着不同的清晰度。
chapters.textEn: Columns and paired towers have regular outlines; nearer leaves give them irregular edges. The distance appears through these gaps, with different degrees of clarity.
